note: Each package name and each variable below was read off the npm registry and that package's own readme on the date above. What cannot be checked from here is whether a vendor's free tier still is one, which is why every entry says what it will ask you for.

servers.label: SearXNG
servers.note: Web search with no account, no key and no card: it queries a SearXNG instance, which is a metasearch service you point it at — your own, or one you already use. This is what Agbrte has instead of a search tool, and the fetch tool reads a page once you have its address.

asks.SEARXNG_URL: The instance to query, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080 for one you run yourself.

servers.label: Tavily
servers.note: Web search built for agents: results come back summarised rather than as a page of links. A free account and an API key, no card.

asks.TAVILY_API_KEY: From app.tavily.com — the free plan is enough to try it.

servers.label: GitHub
servers.note: Issues, pull requests and code search on repositories the token can see. A personal access token, free, scoped to what you actually want reachable from a session.

asks.GITHUB_TOKEN: A personal access token, scoped to the repositories you want reachable.
